channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: ‘Zombified’ C.D.C., Hobbled by Cuts, Struggles to Fulfill Scientific Mission
item.description: The agency has lost its independence and nearly a third of its staff, as Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and associates have tightened control.

item.title: NPR: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents
item.description: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran. It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.

item.title: BBC News: Man City legal fight could spiral out of control, former Premier League club executive warns
item.description: Christian Purslow's comments come after Manchester City was found guilty of dozens of financial rule charges brought by the Premier League.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘Refusing to meet Trump was an easy no’: Colin Kaepernick on being ‘blackballed’ for taking the knee, racism, and why he’s still ready to play
item.description: Ten years ago, the San Francisco 49ers quarterback refused to stand for the national anthem. He was accused of disrespecting the flag, the game, and America. In a rare interview, he talks about inspiring a global gesture…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Egypt to rest Salah in South Sudan AFCON qualifier over pitch concerns
item.description: Egyptian FA has decided to rest Salah to protect him from playing on artificial turf, which is likelier to cause injury.

item.title: Ars Technica: Can Trump ever be wrong? His pick to lead FDA refused to say.
item.description: Heidi Overton faced questions focused on vaccines, birth control, and vapes.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Who Killed Paulina Borsook’s Career?
item.description: A quarter-century ago, Borsook published a wildly prophetic, penetrating book about Silicon Valley called Cyberselfish. Then she disappeared.

item.title: WIRED Science: A Gravitational Battle Within the Earth Is Changing the Length of Days
item.description: A competition between the gravity of the inner core and other forces in the mantle is altering the Earth's rotation.

item.title: WIRED Business: Appeals Court Lets the Pentagon Designate Anthropic a Supply-Chain Risk
item.description: The AI lab had argued multiple violations of its rights, but a divided panel of judges sided with the Trump administration.

item.title: The New Yorker: Nolan Wells’s Family Still Wants Answers
item.description: A Mississippi grand jury declined to bring charges in connection with the death of a Black teen-ager during a boating trip, but it’s still unclear exactly how he died.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Woman Sleeping With a Nice New Guy… and a Bad Ex
item.description: In this week’s story, a 32-year-old figures out her plus-one for a friend’s wedding.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Oheka, the Long Island Xanadu, Is Up for Sale
item.description: It’s been the backdrop to Succession’s “boar on the floor” scene, Taylor Swift’s “Blank Space” video, and countless rich-person weddings.

item.title: Fox59: Lucas Oil Stadium's roof open for Colts' matchup with Texans on Sunday
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — The roof is open as Colts prepare to defend home turf against the Houston Texans. The Indianapolis Colts enter the matchup with an 0-2 record. Last week, the Colts lost to the Chiefs while the Texans fell…
